aggregate_sha256_definition: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 concatenation of '<file_sha256>  <package-relative-path>\n' for all 5 payload JSON files sorted lexicographically by package-relative path; manifest.json is excluded.

index_schema.container: JSON object keyed by dataset scene identifier

entry.context: ordered list of unique, non-negative integer frame indices
entry.target: non-empty list of unique, non-negative integer frame indices disjoint from context

index_schema.null_entries: permitted by the loader but absent from this package
index_schema.runtime_policy: Use every stored target. Canonical files contain exactly the requested context count, so runtime full-range selection is an identity operation. Context ordering remains as stored.

provenance.source: Byte-for-byte copies of the canonical tracked selections previously stored under assets/evaluation/<task>/.
provenance.trust_boundary: The files and per-file hashes are authoritative release metadata. The original random seeds and complete index-generation command lineage were not recoverable from the accepted repository, so this package does not claim to regenerate the selections from raw datasets.

dl3dv_pose.schema: <root>/test.json maps scene identifiers to relative ZIP paths; each ZIP contains transforms.json or <scene>/transforms.json and referenced image payloads.

license_privacy_audit.repository_license: MIT; see LICENSE. The repository license does not grant rights to upstream datasets.
explicitly_excluded: filesystem paths, hostnames, credentials, or access tokens
license_privacy_audit.privacy_review: Schema and value-shape inspection found no direct personal data or secrets. Opaque upstream scene identifiers were not decoded.
license_privacy_audit.license_review: Redistribution rights for dataset-derived selection metadata are not established by the code license. Public distributors must review and comply with the DL3DV terms.
